corrected_answer: Implement a dependency-light typed Python percentile helper. Assumptions: all latencies are finite, non-negative real numbers in one declared unit; the function does not mutate caller data; and p is a finite number in [0, 1]. Materialize the iterable once, reject empty input with ValueError, reject bools/non-numeric/NaN/infinite/negative values, sort the copy, and use Hyndman-Fan type-7 linear interpolation at position p*(n-1). Tests must cover singleton and extrema, [0, 10] interpolation, unsorted input and immutability, empty input, invalid p, bools, non-numeric values, NaN/infinity, and negatives. State O(n log n) time and O(n) space. Sampling, timestamps, aggregation/window selection, units, and whether type 7 matches the consumer are external assumptions requiring confirmation; do not claim production behavior without evidence.
